facts.fact: Max 自认是个蠢货——红发 Flora 像被火包围，是一股力量
facts.anchor: She’s a force, and I was a dumbass.

facts.fact: Max 谈到 Ted 时放话：若查出他对 Bailey 做过什么，就亲手宰了他
facts.anchor: If I find out he did anything to Bailey, I’ll hunt him down and kill him with my bare hands.

facts.fact: Bailey 透露 Ted 曾给他吃牛肚，看着他吐还大笑
facts.anchor: Ted gave me tripe once. I literally ran to the toilet and threw it straight up while he laughed.

facts.fact: Max 的愤怒来自往事：他每次打电话，Ted 就抢走电话威胁以骚扰罪举报他
facts.anchor: Ted took the phone from Els and told me he’d report me for harassment

facts.fact: Flora 教 Bailey 追女生的招：烤饼干放她柜子上、附配料表、看她的反应
facts.anchor: Just leave them on her locker, with a list of ingredients in case she can’t eat certain things, and watch her joy.

facts.fact: 别的家长碰 Flora 手臂时她眼皮抽动——Max 看穿她藏得极好的焦虑，咳嗽吓退对方
facts.anchor: As one of the other dads touches Flora’s arm, her eye twitches. She’s excellent at hiding her anxiety, but I see it.

facts.fact: Flora 把 Max 拉到后屋训斥：侮辱 Bailey 只会毁掉关系，要给的是时间与欣赏
facts.anchor: You need to give him your time and appreciation, not whatever the fuck that was.

facts.fact: Bailey 当面感谢 Flora 为他出头，回家路上说「你该道歉」——Max 掉头开回学校
facts.anchor: Thank you for standing up for me, Flora.
